svg.aria-label: Two JSON texts that differ in key order and number spelling, {"b": 2.50, "a": 1.0} and {"a": 1, "b": 2.5e0}, are both read and encoded to the same canonical bytes, {"a":1,"b":2.5}, and so to the same SHA-256 digest.
svg.title: Two JSON texts that differ in key order and number spelling, {"b": 2.50, "a": 1.0} and {"a": 1, "b": 2.5e0}, are both read and encoded to the same canonical bytes, {"a":1,"b":2.5}, and so to the same SHA-256 digest.
